facts.business: Pasupati Spinning & Weaving Mills Limited manufactures sewing threads (contributing 90-95% of revenue), knitted garments, and provides logistics and warehousing services.

auditor.name: B K Shroff & Co. Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-accounting of additional compensation claim of Rs.614.64 Lacs for factory land acquired by Government of Haryana; Emphasis of matter on adequacy of debtor provisions and missing inventory at sealed premises (stocks Rs.172.16 lacs, PPE Rs.15.77 lacs).

key_risks: 50% US tariff impacting garment export demand
Pollution department restrictions causing operational bottlenecks
Dependence on Indian garment exporters for sewing thread demand
Accumulated losses and past BIFR sickness status
Uncertain recovery of government compensation and tax assets
Missing inventory at sealed premises (Rs.172.16 lacs stock, Rs.15.77 lacs PPE)
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions conducted at arm's length in ordinary course of business; details in Form AOC-2 (Annexure D); policy available at www.pasupatitextiles.com
